Segnala offerta di lavoro About Us We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence. As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations. About Energy Systems We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry. About The Role At DNV, our Digital & Data Solutions (DDS) business combines deep industry expertise with advanced analytics, software, and digital technologies to help customers become more efficient, resilient, and sustainable. We develop data-driven solutions that enable renewable energy owners and operators to maximize asset performance, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate the energy transition. We're looking for a commercially driven Sales Business Developer to expand our presence and support growth across Southern Europe, with high focus on the Italian market. This is a strategic business development role focused on building long-term customer relationships, managing complex sales opportunities, and driving market development for our portfolio of renewable energy monitoring and analytics solutions. This role is based at any of the listed DNV's offices in Italy and combines customer engagement, market development, and solution-based selling. Travel is primarily linked to customer meetings, industry events, and international business activities, averaging approximately one week per month. What You’ll Do As Sales Business Developer, you will be responsible for developing business opportunities and managing the full sales lifecycle for DNV's digital solutions within the renewable energy sector. You Will Drive business development across the region by identifying, developing, and converting new commercial opportunities. Build and maintain trusted relationships with renewable energy developers, owners, operators, EPCs, and asset managers, ensuring long-term partnership development. Lead complex consultative sales processes, from initial engagement through proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution. Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers understand how digital technologies, analytics, and monitoring solutions can improve operational and commercial performance. Collaborate with technical specialists and solution experts to develop tailored proposals for the clients. Represent DNV at industry conferences, exhibitions, and renewable energy events in Italy and abroad. Provide market intelligence and customer insights to regional and global stakeholders to support business strategy and product development. Contribute to annual sales planning, forecasting, and achievement of the team’s commercial targets. Reporting directly to the Europe Regional Manager, you will play a key role in shaping DNV's market presence and growth strategy in the region. What we offer Work with a highly engaged team in an environment where trust and teamwork are core values. A job in a hybrid working model with a home base in any of the listed DNV offices. A working week of 37.5 hours (for candidates located in Italy). An attractive benefit package depending on the country of employment. Continuous training and professional improvement opportunities. A position at the heart of innovation in the green energy industry For candidates located in Italy: salary range between €45.000 and €55.000 gross per year. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity. About You We are interested in speaking with professionals who combine strong commercial instincts with the ability to build credibility in technical conversations. To Succeed In This Role, You Will Bring A bachelor's degree in engineering, energy, business, or another relevant discipline. Fluent Italian and English communication skills, both written and spoken. At least 5 years of experience in business development, solution sales, account management, or commercial roles within renewable energy, power, industrial software, automation, or related sectors, including proven experience in managing complex B2B sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and long decision-making processes. Experience selling technology, software, digital solutions, industrial systems, or technical services. A strong professional network within the Italian renewable energy market. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. A strategic and consultative sales approach focused on creating long-term customer value. This Role Will Suit You If You Enjoy building business relationships more than high-volume transactional selling. Prefer managing key customer opportunities rather than spending most of your time travelling between sites. Are comfortable working from an office and collaborating closely with colleagues across Europe. Want to be part of the digital transformation of the renewable energy industry. Thrive in an international environment with exposure to customers and stakeholders across multiple markets. Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices. Condurre analisi di mercato e vendite, traducendo dati e KPI in insight e raccomandazioni. Progettare, eseguire e misurare campagne commerciali multicanale (in‑store, promo locali, OOH, CRM, radio, attività drive‑to‑store). Gestire tutte le attività di Local Store Marketing per nuove aperture: materiali POP, comunicazione, coordinamento fornitori e stakeholder. Collaborare al lancio di nuovi prodotti e alle iniziative di posizionamento e go‑to‑market. Monitorare le performance dei ristoranti e delle iniziative tramite reportistica avanzata e revisione dei KPI. Coordinare budget, fornitori, agenzie creative e centri media assicurando efficienza e coerenza con le linee guida internazionali. Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team Operations per garantire puntualità, correttezza e qualità dei materiali in‑store (POP, cartellonistica, chioschi digitali, aggiornamenti prezzi, flussi informativi). Partecipare a progetti strategici su innovazione, digitalizzazione e potenziamento dei sistemi IT retail. Supportare la definizione del calendario marketing annuale in collaborazione con i team interni e HQ. Competenze ed esperienza Cerchiamo una persona che abbia: Laurea in Marketing, Economia, Comunicazione o affini. 5+ anni di esperienza in ruoli di trade marketing / retail marketing, preferibilmente in ristorazione organizzata, FMCG o retail strutturato. Solida capacità analitica: KPI, vendite, performance store, insight; ottima padronanza di Excel, Power BI. Esperienza diretta con attività in‑store e gestione store/local marketing. Capacità di gestire stakeholder molto diversi: proprietari di centri commerciali, store manager, agenzie, headquarters esteri. Ottime doti di problem solving, proattività e autonomia. Inglese fluente; lo spagnolo rappresenta un plus. Disponibilità a trasferte giornaliere su territorio nazionale. Forte spirito di iniziativa e orientamento al risultato. Capacità di lavorare in contesti dinamici, con priorità mutevoli. Attitudine "hands‑on", pragmatica, concreta. Energia, velocità, voglia di crescere e di "fare la differenza". At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Data-driven campaign management. Own acquisition campaigns for a product end to end—from hypothesis to launch, to iteration—running structured data-driven retrospectives to extract learnings and translating them into new creative solutions. Content creation. Leverage AI tools to produce high-performing, cross-channel visual content, directing hand-picked creators and writing tailored briefs to deliver the right message to each audience. Channels and partnerships. Coordinate the execution of campaigns across in-house production, external contributors, and client-facing advertising partnerships, working closely with creative, marketing, and business teams. Trend monitoring. Track social media trends, competitor activity, and emerging creative practices to stay ahead of the curve. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £47,660 to £68,579 in London and from €46,027 to €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £151,436 in London or €145,430 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. People leave a call with you smiling Requirements • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in digital marketing with B2B SaaS products • Strong expertise in content marketing, SEO and GEO (getting found on Google and in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity) • Strong experience with HubSpot: workflows, lead tracking, reporting • Native Italian, fluent in English • Bonus: experience at an early-stage startup or scale-up What we offer • RAL: 25k–38k EUR based on experience • A clear path to Head of Marketing, earned by results rather than seniority • Huge ownership from day one • A direct line to the founders, with no layers in between • AI at the foundation of our product, not as a buzzword • The chance to help build Italy's leading fleet platform and take it to Europe • A hybrid setup, with 3 days per week in our Milan office Hiring process We like to keep things simple, fast, and transparent. 01. Intro Call – 30 minutes Meet one of the founders. We'll talk about your motivation, what you've built so far, and what you're looking for. 02. Practical Case A short, real challenge: show us how you'd make Flottando impossible to ignore in the next 60-90 days from day 1 u join us. 03. Final Interview – 45 minutes: Walk us through your case with the CEO and the team. 04. Offer We aim to complete the process within 2–6 weeks. One last thing: We can teach you fleets, fringe benefits and how fines management work. What we're really looking for is harder to teach: Hunger. Ownership. Creativity. And the instinct to ship. If you read this and thought "finally, a job where I can just build," we'd love to meet you. Join Flottando and help us make fleet management exciting. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 84.200,00 €/yr - 101.600,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Yellow Tech - The AI ​​Transformation Company Sofia Ghisetti Sofia Ghisetti Head of Operations and People @Yellow Tech, the AI Transformation Company Chi siamo Yellow Tech è una società di consulenza strategica specializzata nella trasformazione AI: aiutiamo le aziende a comprendere e adottare l'intelligenza artificiale. Siamo una società AI-first , fatta di umani e agenti AI che lavorano insieme, nata con l'arrivo degli LLM e fully-bootstrapped: ci sosteniamo da soli e decidiamo noi cosa costruire. Il team Business Development trova le aziende e le qualifica; lo Strategist capisce il bisogno, chiude il progetto e lo coordina; i Trainer formano le persone (AI Academy), gli Engineer costruiscono agenti (AI Factory). 💰 Compensation Compensation totale annuale on target: €84.200-€101.600 RAL: €50.500-€57.000 in base alla seniority Buoni pasto e welfare: €2.500 l'anno Variabile annuale in base ai target del team €31.200-€42.100, uncapped, erogato trimestralmente Stock option disponibili 🔎 Le tue responsabilità Guidi un team di AI Strategist, da 4 a 6 persone, e rispondi dei risultati commerciali di tutto il gruppo. È un ruolo per chi ha già guidato un team e ha venduto e portato a termine progetti di trasformazione digitale o AI con il top management. Il ruolo comprende: Guidare e far crescere il team. Fai coaching, 1:1 e confronti periodici su obiettivi e risultati con ogni Strategist. Decidi chi entra nel team: i nuovi ingressi li intervisti e li approvi tu. Assegnare e chiudere i deal. Prendi le opportunità qualificate dal Business Development, ne apri di nuove con la tua rete e decidi quale Strategist segue ogni deal. Nei deal più complessi entri in prima persona, dalla discovery alla negoziazione. Tenere la relazione con i clienti del team. Per CEO e prime linee dei clienti del team sei il riferimento su prezzo, steering, rinnovi ed escalation. Trasformi il primo progetto in un rapporto che dura anni. Portare i progetti a risultato. Coordini il lavoro del team sui progetti di AI Academy e AI Factory insieme a Trainer ed Engineer, e intervieni quando tempi, scope o qualità escono dal piano. 📈 Il tuo percorso Nelle prime settimane conosci i clienti e i deal aperti del team e fai il primo 1:1 con ogni Strategist. Entro i primi 3 mesi guidi il team in autonomia. Hai fissato con ogni Strategist obiettivi e piano di crescita, e i nuovi deal li assegni tu. Dopo 12 mesi puoi accedere al livello successivo sulla base dei risultati del team e di criteri di performance quantitativi e trasparenti. 💛 Cosa offriamo Un posto in prima linea sull'AI. Lavori ogni giorno con gli strumenti più avanzati. La formazione che portiamo ai clienti è anche parte del tuo percorso: mentorship, peer learning e sessioni pratiche per rimanere sempre aggiornato sul mondo AI. Talent density. Lavorerai a fianco alle persone più forti sul tema più hot del momento, con un team giovane con zero ego, collaborazione, rispetto e feedback diretto. Crescita e impatto. Ogni ruolo ha un percorso di crescita scritto, da Junior a Head of, con criteri misurabili che conosci dal primo giorno: si cresce per risultati, non per anzianità. E si cresce in fretta, perché lavori in team piccoli con un impatto enorme e grande autonomia fin da subito. Retribuzione result-driven. La componente variabile è direttamente collegata ai risultati ed è senza tetto massimo : più valore generi, maggiore è il riconoscimento economico del tuo contributo. 🪜 Il processo di selezione Form online Intervista tecnica online Interview fit online Colloquio finale con CEO, in presenza a Milano 📍 Prima di candidarti Lavoriamo principalmente in presenza, nel nostro ufficio (Corvetto, Milano). Siamo una realtà early-stage con grandi ambizioni e crediamo che stare insieme, giorno dopo giorno, sia fondamentale per costruire energia, allineamento e risultati. Detto questo, operiamo con flessibilità e buon senso: il lavoro da remoto è possibile quando serve. Gli LLM sono arrivati tre anni fa e hanno creato un mercato nuovo. La finestra è grandissima ed è aperta adesso; per starci davanti bisogna lavorare meglio e più degli altri. Chi cerca ritmi prevedibili qui non sta bene. Serve l'italiano da madrelingua. I requisiti li scriviamo come orientamento, non come sbarramento: se il ruolo ti attira e pensi di poter crescere in fretta, candidati anche con un profilo non in linea. È già successo, ed è finita bene. Livello retribuzione di base 54.000,00 €/yr - 75.000,00 €/anno The Vendor Success Manager (VSM) acts as the primary business owner and strategic interface for assigned vendor brands, driving revenue growth, market share, and program adoption across the country or cluster. This role ensures alignment between vendor global objectives and Westcon-Comstor local execution, translating vendor strategies into actionable plans and orchestrating cross-functional resources to deliver measurable outcomes. Acting as the face of the vendor internally and externally, the VSM builds trust-based relationships with vendor executives, partners, and internal teams while ensuring governance, compliance, and operational excellence. Success requires proactive engagement, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to influence both vendor and internal stakeholders. Vendor Relationship Management * Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned vendors. * Build and maintain multi-level relationships across vendor sales, marketing, and operations. * Represent Westcon-Comstor at vendor headquarters, events, and strategic meetings. * Cascade vendor objectives internally to ensure alignment and execution. Business Planning & Execution * Develop and own the Vendor Market Plan with clear objectives, targets, and enablement actions. * Deliver revenue, margin, and profitability goals across the vendor portfolio. * Deploy campaigns, promotions, and investments at local level; adjust plans based on performance. * Provide structured progress updates to management and vendor counterparts. Resource Mobilization & Cross-Functional Alignment * Engage internal teams (PSMs, IAMs, IPSMs, Solution Architects) to drive vendor pipeline execution. * Ensure seamless coordination between field and inside sales for joint opportunities. * Act as escalation point for vendor-related issues impacting execution. Sales Enablement & Acceleration * Train sales teams on vendor products, tools, and programs to ensure commercial readiness. * Drive adoption of vendor programs by partners and internal teams. * Identify and remove growth blockers to accelerate deal velocity. Pipeline Stimulation & Demand Generation * Generate new opportunities through campaigns, account mapping, and joint planning. * Track active deals with IAMs and PSMs to ensure timely closure. * Support vendor-specific sales blitzes and digital initiatives (Power BI, 3DLab). Partner Engagement & Development * Identify and recruit new vendor-aligned partners; manage focus accounts jointly with PSMs. * Support partner enablement through certifications, rebates, and program participation. * Monitor partner performance and adjust plans to meet vendor objectives. Marketing & MDF Governance * Execute vendor campaigns and ensure brand consistency across all communications. * Maximize MDF impact through ROI-driven planning and transparent reporting. * Represent vendor and Westcon-Comstor at trade shows, events, and joint partner activities. Forecasting & Reporting * Provide accurate forecasts for vendor sales and margin projections. * Track performance versus targets and analyze trends to adapt strategies. * Maintain CRM discipline and timely reporting for governance compliance. Compliance & Program Governance * Ensure adherence to vendor requirements, processes, and ethical standards. * Manage MDF responsibly, ensuring transparency and audit readiness. Must-Have Skills & Experience * Proven experience in vendor management, channel sales, or business development roles. * Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence vendor and internal stakeholders. * Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills. * Language: Italian & English (business fluency). Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience * Familiarity with multi-vendor IT distribution and channel ecosystems. * Experience in marketing campaign execution and MDF governance. * Additional languages and international exposure. Education & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or related field (or equivalent experience). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Vendor revenue and margin attainment at country/cluster level. * Market share growth and pipeline coverage ratio (≥3× target). * Partner recruitment and activation metrics. * Campaign execution and MDF ROI. * Training and enablement impact (sales readiness and certification rates). * Forecast accuracy and CRM data quality. * Vendor satisfaction scores and governance compliance. Company Values & Culture Fit This role demands agility, accountability, and a passion for driving vendor success. Success means owning outcomes, enabling growth, and fostering a collaborative, tech-savvy sales culture. Salary Range: Compensation will be determined within the advertised range based solely on the candidate's experience, skills, and expertise, ensuring a fair and consistent approach for all applicants. Segnala offerta di lavoro Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid) We Are RTB House is a next-generation performance demand-side platform (DSP) that uses proprietary Deep Learning AI algorithms to help brands grow. The company is the market leader in driving performance using Deep Learning across the entire purchase funnel. Founded in 2012 and now operating in 90+ markets, RTB House has always been private-by-design. It embraces first-party advertising and a relentless approach to innovation. RTB House offers end-to-end Deep Learning-powered AdTech products and solutions to maximize conversion, drive new customer acquisition, create engagement, and fuel long-term demand for a global base of clients. In 2026, RTB House launched rtb.com, a self-service platform specifically designed to allow small and medium-sized businesses and agencies to deploy auto-built creatives and maximize performance on any budget. Our Italian team consists of 23 people and is an integral part of our company’s EMEA presence. We combine local expertise with our broader company vision, ensuring innovative solutions that align with diverse market needs. The Account Management Team is at the heart of our success. We work hand in hand with clients to maximize campaign performance and expand partnerships, playing a crucial role in both revenue growth ( upselling & cross-selling ) and building long-term relationships. Why RTB House? If you’re looking for a place where you can combine your analytical mindset, commercial drive, and ability to build strong client relationships - becoming a trusted advisor and valued partner - RTB House could be the right fit for you! You Will Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic client accounts, ensuring long-term success and satisfaction; Strengthen client relationships through regular presentations, performance reviews, and in-person meetings; Identify growth opportunities and maximize revenue via upsell and cross-sell initiatives; Conduct in-depth campaign analysis, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations; Build tailored strategies aligned with client goals; Collaborate closely with Sales and Technical Account Management teams to ensure smooth onboarding and ongoing support; Monitor key KPIs and campaign margins, proactively suggesting optimizations; Obtain, review and process campaign orders; ensure timely payments for our services. Desired Experience 8+ years of experience in digital advertising; Preferably experience working in AdTech within DSPs, agencies, or advertisers (performance and/or awareness campaigns); Strong analytical and reporting skills, with Excel and PowerPoint proficiency; Proven ability to manage clients directly and drive commercial opportunities; Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders; A consultative mindset: understanding client needs and translating them into actionable solutions; Results-driven, proactive, and problem-solving approach; High level of motivation, willingness to learn and a positive, can-do attitude; Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; Fluency in Italian and English (C1 level); Based in Milan. We Offer A unique chance to join one of the most dynamic players in digital advertising (1000+ specialists in 30+ markets, 3,000+ live campaigns worldwide); Competitive package: base salary + bonus, meal vouchers, personal development budget; Hybrid working model promoting real work-life balance; An amazing onboarding process to make sure you are equipped with all the necessary knowledge and tools to excel; Unique learning opportunities from commercial and HQ business support teams; Numerous opportunities to build your own path of self-development; Team building events and trips away! Work in a truly international environment with dynamic people in one of the fastest-growing segments of online advertising! The base salary range for this position is €58,000 - €75,000 gross per year + variable, determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria. This position is governed by the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for the Commerce Sector - Confcommercio (CNEL H011) and is classified at quadro . Apply now! You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you are passionate about digital marketing, send us your CV, and we'll review it. motivazione: Il candidato possiede più di 5 anni di esperienza in digital sales e marketing con gestione di CRM (HubSpot) e budget fino a €400k, soddisfacendo il requisito di almeno 2‑3 anni di vendita di servizi ICT e l’uso di sistemi CRM. Il gap più rilevante è che la posizione è “Junior Sales Consultant” e il profilo è più senior (manager con riporto al board), ma la seniority non è un requisito bloccante e la sua esperienza in contesti tech e scale‑up è in linea con l’ambiente aziendale.

Italy, Milano Italy Italy, Milano Italy
Siamo la Tech Company leader in Europa che da oltre 45 anni supporta l’innovazione digitale. Portare il digitale in ogni impresa è la nostra missione. Come? Mettendo al centro il cliente e diventando il partner di riferimento di professionisti, piccole, medie e grandi aziende offrendo soluzioni e servizi personalizzati per ottimizzare i processi aziendali, che si tratti di gestire le risorse umane, le relazioni con i clienti, la fatturazione elettronica o i pagamenti digitali. In ENTERPRISE siamo il partner ideale per le aziende che ambiscono alla trasformazione digitale. Comprendiamo le sfide di un mercato in continua evoluzione e per questo abbiamo progettato soluzioni su misura per realtà ambiziose, orientate alla crescita e desiderose di mantenere il pieno controllo delle proprie performance. Offriamo un supporto completo per ottimizzare le aree chiave di ogni attività, dall'amministrazione e gestione del personale, alle vendite e acquisti, dalla gestione dei progetti alla produzione e logistica. Diventa protagonista nella vendita di soluzioni innovative come Junior Sales Consultant : avrai un ruolo chiave nell’ampliamento del mercato di riferimento e accompagnerai i clienti verso le migliori soluzioni applicative in ambito HR, Payroll e HCR. Gestirai in prima persona tutte le fasi della trattativa commerciale, dalla proposta alla chiusura, mettendo al centro le esigenze dei clienti. Il profilo che cerchiamo ha: Esperienza commerciale: almeno 2-3 anni nella vendita di servizi/prodotti ICT, Telco o simili, con consolidata esperienza nell’uso di sistemi CRM. Una Laurea o un diploma in materie economiche o ingegneristiche. Predisposizione all’uso di tool digitali di collaborazione di ultima generazione. Passione per l’ICT e la digital transformation, forte motivazione e spirito imprenditoriale. Eccellenti capacità relazionali, comunicative e organizzative, con orientamento al risultato e attenzione alla customer satisfaction. Precisione, affidabilità, curiosità e capacità di muoversi con efficacia in contesti complessi e tecnologicamente evoluti. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Ti rivedi nelle competenze che cerchiamo? Ottimo inizio! Ma vogliamo anche persone che, grazie al loro growth mindset , vedano ogni sfida come un'opportunità straordinaria di crescita e che riflettano le soft skills che ci distinguono, dando vita ai nostri valori. IMPRENDITORIALITÀ - è il motore che ci spinge a eccellere, a innovare e sfidare noi stessi per il successo nostro e dell'azienda. Siamo proattivi, responsabili e focalizzati sul cliente, sempre pronti a mettere in discussione lo status quo e a raggiungere risultati straordinari. INNOVAZIONE - è il faro che illumina il nostro percorso muovendoci in un’ambiente ricco di esperienze, conoscenze e prospettive differenti. Non temiamo l’errore, lavoriamo in un ambiente fertile per lo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative. INCLUSIONE – è il sentimento che guida il nostro rapporto tra individui, ognuno portatore di una storia e di un’esperienza differente. Siamo custodi di un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo che possa valorizzare le caratteristiche di ciascuno. Hai le competenze e l’attitudine richieste? Candidati ora in modo semplice e veloce e monitora la tua application sul nostro portale! Cosa ti offriamo: ​ Crediamo che il rapporto con le nostre persone si fondi su fiducia, chiarezza degli obiettivi e piena autonomia nel raggiungerli. Grazie al supporto dell'AI, dedichiamo più tempo alle attività che generano valore: pensare, creare, innovare e prendere decisioni. Qui il valore del lavoro si misura sulla qualità del contributo, sui risultati raggiunti e sulla responsabilità di ciascuno. È proprio questa visione, costruita nel tempo, ad aver reso naturale la nostra settimana lavorativa di 4 giorni : un giorno in più ogni settimana da dedicare a ciò che conta per te. Retribuzione totale: € 38.000 – € 51.000 Comprensiva della componente variabile legata ai risultati. Riferimento full-time. ​ Wellbeing Digital Wallet: a partire da € 2.800 annui Budget personale per il tuo benessere: viaggi, spese mediche, supporto alla genitorialità, sport e rimborsi per servizi alle persone come asilo nido, caregiver, etc… ​ Flessibilità : lavoriamo in modalità ibrida, con autonomia su quando essere in sede. Per noi la presenza ha senso quando migliora il lavoro: vieni quando il confronto con i colleghi fa la differenza, non per presenza ma per efficacia. Crescita : offriamo percorsi di formazione personalizzati e opportunità concrete di sviluppo in un gruppo internazionale in continua evoluzione. Ambiente : promuoviamo un contesto inclusivo, basato su fiducia, collaborazione e valorizzazione delle differenze. ​ Impatto : lavoriamo ogni giorno per generare valore per persone, imprese e comunità attraverso il digitale. Patente B, necessaria per spostamenti e trasferte legate alle attività del ruolo

Make An Impact That Matters Deloitte opera in Italia dal 1923 ed è un punto di riferimento per imprese e istituzioni nei servizi professionali, coniugando l’expertise internazionale del network con una profonda conoscenza del contesto economico e normativo nazionale. Al 31 maggio 2025, Deloitte in Italia conta 15.000 professioniste e professionisti, un fatturato superiore a 1,7 miliardi di euro e una presenza capillare in 23 città sul territorio. Attraverso un’offerta multidisciplinare, supporta organizzazioni di diverse dimensioni e settori nell’affrontare trasformazioni complesse, dalla digitalizzazione alla sostenibilità, rispondendo alle crescenti esigenze di investitori, istituzioni e stakeholder. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che – in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti – hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale. Assistant Manager - Deal Transformation Strategy & Operations Stiamo cercando una figura Assistant Manager da inserire nel team Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration di Deloitte nella sede di Milano e Roma che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid. Il team di Deal Transformation affianca i clienti in ogni fase di una operazione M&A, dalla fase pre-deal con business e operational due diligence a supporto della decisione di investimento, fino alla creazione di valore post-deal tramite integrazione e iniziative di performance improvement. Your Role I n quanto Assistant Manager avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con il Top Management delle aziende clienti, focalizzandoti su tematiche di Pre Deal e Post Deal all’interno di operazioni di finanza straordinaria (M&A). Nello specifico, la risorsa si occuperà di: M&A Integration & Separation Svolgere attività di separation due diligence/ assessment , analizzando la complessità della separation, la standalone readiness, le implicazioni operative e organizzative, i requisiti di TSA, gli stranded costs e i principali rischi di execution Supportare il design e l’execution di programmi complessi di M&A integration e separation , dalla preparazione alla Day 1 fino alla fase di post-closing, inclusa la gestione degli Integration/Separation Management Offices (IMO/SMO). Supportare il design e l’implementazione delle strategie di integration e separation , degli standalone e target operating models, delle strutture di governance, dei Day 1 e Day 100 plans e delle execution roadmaps. Coordinare i c ross-functional workstreams , monitorando interdipendenze, rischi e critical decisions e assicurando la corretta gestione delle criticità secondo gli escalation paths definiti. Value Creation Gestire l’intero processo di synergy assessment, dalla identificazione delle opportunità di sinergia alla loro quantificazione , dall’implementation planning al value capture, con l’obiettivo di massimizzare la realizzazione delle sinergie previste dalle operazioni di M&A. I dentificare e quantificare one-off costs, dis-synergies, stranded costs e value leakage , definendo azioni di mitigazione e supportando il cost management. Supportare lo sviluppo di business cases e value creation initiatives , valutandone l’impatto economico e operativo. Sviluppare modelli di tracking per monitorare l’avanzamento delle value creation initiatives e la realizzazione del valore rispetto ai business cases e ai target, identificando variances, risks e opportunities. Programme Management & Governance Strutturare e gestire programmi complessi , definendo l’integrated plan, i meccanismi di governance e gli strumenti di monitoraggio e gestione delle criticità, inclusi RAID e decision logs. Monitorare l’avanzamento del programma , verificando milestone, rischi e interdipendenze e gestendo le principali criticità attraverso gli opportuni escalation paths. Predisporre reporting package per il Top Management e gli Steering Committee , sintetizzando stato di avanzamento, principali rischi e criticità e le decisioni richieste. Facilitare gli incontri di governance, workshop e working sessions con senior client stakeholders e functional teams , favorendo l’allineamento tra le diverse funzioni e supportando il processo decisionale. Stakeholder Management Costruire e gestire relazioni solide con client executives e functional leaders , comprendendone esigenze e priorità e assicurando un efficace coinvolgimento nelle diverse fasi del programma Collaborare con team Deloitte multidisciplinari per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni integrate per i clienti e individuare nuove opportunità commerciali. Favorire una collaborazione efficace tra client teams e Deloitte professionals, garantendo l'allineamento tra workstreams, stakeholders e programme priorities. Presentare analisi e raccomandazioni a senior management, C-level executives e Steering Committee , comunicando in modo chiaro i principali elementi di valutazione e supportando il processo decisionale. What we offer La retribuzione fissa prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra  EUR 44.000 e EUR 47.000 lordi annui per il grade Assistant Manager . L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirements 4-5 anni di esperienza professionale in management consulting, transaction advisory, business transformation e/o M&A Integration & Separation,. Buona conoscenza del M&A lifecycle e delle principali sfide operative e organizzative legate a integration, separation e corporate transformation , maturata attraverso il coinvolgimento nella gestione di programmi di Post-Merger Integration, Separation, Carve-out e/o large-scale transformation. Capacità di gestire functional workstreams , coordinando le attività e le principali interdipendenze e supportando l’execution di programmi complessi. Solide capacità di quantitative e business analysis , con la capacità di sviluppare analisi e contribuire a business cases, synergy assessments e value creation initiatives, traducendo i risultati in elementi utili alle raccomandazioni. Offriamo soluzioni innovative e sostenibili in Audit & Assurance, Strategy, Risk & Transaction Advisory, Tax & Legal e Technology & Transformation. Il nostro obiettivo è supportare le aziende nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie al passo con il mercato. In Deloitte la sostenibilità è un tema centrale. Do you enjoy shaping new possibilities? At Accenture, you can help reinvent entire industries, working with the world’s leading companies. You’ll put your expertise to work to shape the future of business and technology, developing cutting-edge solutions that can create new value. Your role and opportunities As a Marketing Measurement Software Sales Manager , you will drive growth for advanced marketing measurement and analytics solutions, helping clients improve marketing effectiveness, optimize investments and turn data and insights into better business decisions. Lead consultative sales conversations with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Analytics, Revenue, Data and Technology, identifying business challenges and translating them into relevant software and analytics opportunities. Position advanced marketing measurement capabilities , including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality, unified measurement, forecasting, optimization and scenario planning, connecting them to measurable business outcomes and ROI. Manage the end-to-end software sales cycle , from prospecting and qualification through solution positioning, demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and closing. Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, industry and technology specialists to shape solutions addressing challenges such as fragmented measurement, disconnected data and the need for faster, more reliable decision-making. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is A1 under the Metalmeccanico National Collective Bargaining Agreement. The gross annual salary range is between 50.000€ and 78.500€. Your qualifications At least 6 years of overall professional experience, including 3+ years in software sales. Bachelor’s degree or higher. Experience in marketing measurement, marketing technology (MarTech), analytics or related software solutions. Good understanding of MMM, MTA, incrementality, sales or brand lift, and unified measurement. Proven experience managing consultative software sales cycles and engaging senior business stakeholders. Strong ability to translate complex measurement and analytics capabilities into clear business value and ROI. Fluent Italian and English. Preferred qualifications Familiarity with MarTech, AdTech, CRM, CDP, retail media, identity, clean rooms and cloud analytics ecosystems. Experience with marketing optimization, forecasting and scenario planning. Experience developing executive-level business cases around marketing and commercial investments. About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. About The Role As Brand Manager Continence Care, you will manage the implementation of the Marketing Strategy for the TENA Brand in Italy, ensuring delivery of sales and market share targets through effective execution and alignment with global guidelines. The role reports directly to the Marketing Manager IT, IB & CH. Working in an international and dynamic environment, you will have strong exposure to Sales, Customer Marketing and global stakeholders, contributing to the development of one of Essity’s key brands. What You Will Do Drive brand growth and profitable market share development, contributing to brand and business performance. Contribute to lead annual brand and marketing planning and manage A&P budget allocation, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and alignment with global strategy. Execute brand campaigns and product innovations, track performance and manage the product lifecycle, including phase-in and phase-out activities. Manage assortment, pricing and product strategy in collaboration with global and cross-functional teams. Analyse market performance and consumer/customer insights, including Nielsen data, translating findings into actionable business and marketing initiatives. Support the definition and execution of media plans, with a focus on digital and paid media effectiveness. Who You Are University Degree in Economics, Marketing or a related field. Around 4 years of experience in Brand Management or similar Marketing roles within an FMCG environment. Previous experience in a multinational environment is highly valued. Fluency in Italian and English is mandatory. Good experience in the development and execution of marketing plans. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret market data and turn insights into actions. Hands-on knowledge of Nielsen or similar market data tools, together with Excel, PowerPoint, and AI tools. Strong collaboration skills and previous exposure to Sales and Customer Marketing. Proactive, autonomous and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. What We Can Offer You We offer a 12-month employment contract starting in January, with a gross annual salary starting from €36,000, in line with CCNL Carta Industria, Level B. The package also includes meal vouchers and an annual bonus. The role offers hybrid working, with up to two days of smart working per week. As the Legnano office is not easily accessible by public transport, having access to a car is recommended. Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere. Segnala offerta di lavoro Description We're Prime Video's International Social Creative Team, a group of pop-culture obsessives dedicated to bringing our Original productions to life on social. We plan, create and distribute platform-native campaigns that connect authentically with audiences, from the moment a title is greenlit to the day it drops and beyond. We obsess over every asset, every caption, every platform moment, because we believe a great social campaign can make a title unmissable. We roll up our sleeves, take bold creative bets, and never settle for average. We're a team of owners who are in it for the long haul: curious, collaborative, and always looking to raise the bar. We like to say it's always Day 1: we're constantly reinventing how we show up on social, breaking things and building better ones along the way. We are looking for a creatively-driven Social Campaign Manager with significant experience producing and executing best-in-class social campaigns for major entertainment brands (agency or client side) to support this work in Italy. Key job responsibilities Help Manage end-to-end Social Campaigns for our Italian Original productions, from conceptualization through to execution and reporting Guide and brief our social agency on content capture and asset development for our Original titles, ensuring each piece of content is tailored to the right platform and audience Build and execute distribution plans across Prime Video's owned handles as well as off-handle channels, including talent, publishers, and partner accounts Help manage relationships with internal stakeholders including leadership, studios, content teams, marketing and PR to align on campaign priorities and creative direction Collaborate with external partners such as agencies, talent, production companies, and influencers to bring campaigns to life in an authentic and culturally resonant way Report on campaign learnings to continuously refine your approach and raise the creative bar Basic Qualifications Professional experience in Social Media Campaigns, with a strong focus on content production and asset development for entertainment or major consumer brands Proven track record of delivering high-quality social campaigns from content capture through to distribution Deep understanding of platform-native content across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels Strong analytical skills: able to read campaign metrics, extract meaningful insights, and translate them into actionable improvements Ability to fluently communicate in Italian and English (oral and written) Experience managing relationships with external partners including talent, production companies, and creative agencies Demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Preferred Qualifications Significant experience delivering integrated, social-first campaigns for entertainment properties or original productions Experience in content capture environments (on-set, marketing days, press junkets) and a strong eye for platform-optimised asset creation Familiarity with off-handle distribution strategies, including talent amplification, publisher partnerships, and influencer ecosystems Comfortable navigating complex internal stakeholder environments, including cross-functional collaboration with studios, content, and leadership teams Experience working within or alongside in-house social teams Transform the everyday for everyone At Siemens, we enable sustainable progress through technology, connecting the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move. We put our people first - creating a diverse, global environment where you can grow, take ownership, and make a real impact from day one. Here, your ideas turn into innovative solutions that transform industries, infrastructure, mobility and everyday life. Your next chapter starts here! Your role: As a Marketing Professional – Digital & Vertical Marketing , you will be part of the EMEA Marketing Team , you will vertical marketing and digital demand generation in Italy translating industry insights, customer needs and business priorities into impactful marketing initiatives You will execute and localize Global and EMEA strategies , while developing Italian market-specific initiatives to address local business priorities and growth opportunities You will also act as a key point of reference for digital marketing performance across multiple EMEA countries , supporting KPI tracking, campaign measurement and performance optimization. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution and a data-driven mindset in a dynamic, international environment. You’ll make an impact by: Develop and execute industry-focused marketing plans, translating market trends, customer needs and business priorities into targeted go-to-market strategies. Build a deep understanding of industry dynamics, customer needs, use cases, buying groups and decision-making journeys to identify growth opportunities and shape effective marketing programs. Define vertical-specific value propositions, messaging and content, translating technology capabilities into relevant customer outcomes and industry narratives. Drive and execute digital demand generation through integrated campaigns, customer journeys, ABM, paid media, content, email, webinars and marketing automation. Execute and localize Global and EMEA marketing programs for the Italian market, adapting propositions, content and activation to specific vertical and customer needs. Develop local vertical initiatives where market dynamics and business opportunities require a tailored approach. Partner with Sales and Business Units to prioritize industries, accounts, buying groups and use cases, connecting marketing activities to demand, pipeline and business growth. Leverage CRM, marketing automation and analytics to measure and optimize engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution and marketing ROI. Activate selected partners and ecosystem players to extend reach and strengthen vertical market penetration. Collaborate closely with EMEA and Global Marketing teams, contributing local market and industry insights, sharing best practices and ensuring alignment with broader marketing strategies. EMEA Digital Performance & Analytics: Act as a key point of reference across multiple EMEA countries for KPI definition, campaign tracking, performance dashboards and reporting, ensuring consistent measurement across markets. What makes you a great match: Core Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields. 5–6 years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in technology, industrial or digital transformation environments. Experience in vertical/industry marketing, digital demand generation and integrated campaigns. Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, ABM, customer journeys and marketing automation. Solid analytical skills and hands-on experience in digital performance measurement, KPI tracking, dashboarding and campaign optimization. Experience with CRM, marketing automation and digital analytics platforms. Ability to translate market insights and performance data into actionable marketing strategies. Strong business orientation, with an understanding of marketing contribution to pipeline and revenue. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional and multicultural teams. Ability to balance Global/EMEA strategies with local market needs, effectively executing central programs while developing local initiatives when required. Fluent English and Italian Preferred Requirements Experience working with industry vertical marketing approaches and segment-specific go-to-market strategies. International working experience or exposure to global marketing environments Curiosity for emerging technologies, market trends, and innovative marketing approaches that support business growth. Awareness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in marketing, including content creation, campaign optimization, customer engagement, analytics, and productivity enhancement. Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging AI-powered tools and technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes. Comfortable operating in matrix and international environments. Strong collaboration and influencing skills. What you’ll benefit from: At Siemens, we foster a results-driven and trust-based environment, offering a flexible hybrid working model that supports both performance and work-life balance. You’ll have access to a comprehensive wellbeing ecosystem, including dedicated parenthood support, health reimbursement programs, and psychological support services. Our welfare offering is designed to enhance overall quality of life, while continuous learning opportunities enable your ongoing personal and professional growth. The Total Target Cash (Base + Variable) Pay Range for this position is € 55.000 – € 70.000 annually. The actual offer will be determined within this range, based on the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and qualifications. No company car. A33: we’re looking for co-founders. If you’re looking for an entrepreneurial role, keep reading. If you’re looking for a job, you can stop here. Who we are A33 is redefining how companies prosper. We’re building a new category that brings together three things: proprietary intelligence, deep knowledge of each sector, and a dedicated human coach for every client. Where we are We have paying customers and they’re happy. We’re still in our pilot phase and signing about one new client a week, with a target of around €20k ARR per client. Now we’re getting ready to scale. Who’s already here A33 was founded by Giorgio Bertolini | LinkedIn. The other co-founders are still in stealth: an A-level founding team, together with top leaders in strategic sectors across food and manufacturing. How we build Everything we do, from our values to our intelligence framework, rests on one idea: harmony between people, planet and profit. That shapes how we run the company from day zero: Lean on purpose. We create value first and keep costs low, so we have more leverage when we scale. A healthy business model from the start. Being frugal makes us focus on what actually works, both for us and for our clients. Profitable by design. We want to be a strongly profitable company so we can keep reinvesting in people and the planet. Who we’re looking for A few exceptional people to lead three areas: Tech and AI: build the intelligence that powers A33 Sales and go-to-market: turn early traction into a repeatable growth engine Operations: make sure we deliver at the same quality as we grow What we expect Full-time commitment. This isn’t a side project. We want you on board as soon as possible, ideally from the beginning of 2027. An owner’s mindset. You take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. Comfort with uncertainty. You build the playbook rather than follow one. What you get A co-founder role, with real equity. At the start we’ll cover expenses and pay what our revenue allows. We’re aiming to move to a full salary before the end of Q2 2027. We need people who are entrepreneurs at heart: people who bring extra energy, stay resilient and create value with us, not just alongside us. Real ownership of your area, from day one. A seat at the table in shaping the category, the product and the culture. Where Varese / Milan / hybrid / remote-first How to reach out No CV needed. Amazon, the global e-commerce leader, is seeking a talented individual to join our Third-Party Marketplace team in Milan as a Deals Account Manager. In this dynamic role, you'll have the opportunity to work with high-potential Sellers in Fashion and Sport, while building AI-native solutions to help them grow their online businesses. Your mission will be to develop customized sales pipelines, design impactful promotions, and ensure seamless execution during key events like Prime Day and Black Friday. This is an exceptional opportunity to kickstart your career at the forefront of the e-commerce revolution. If you're ready to dive in and make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you. At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Data-driven campaign management. Own acquisition campaigns for a product end to end—from hypothesis to launch, to iteration—running structured data-driven retrospectives to extract learnings and translating them into new creative solutions. Content creation. Leverage AI tools to produce high-performing, cross-channel visual content, directing hand-picked creators and writing tailored briefs to deliver the right message to each audience. Channels and partnerships. Coordinate the execution of campaigns across in-house production, external contributors, and client-facing advertising partnerships, working closely with creative, marketing, and business teams. Trend monitoring. Track social media trends, competitor activity, and emerging creative practices to stay ahead of the curve. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £47,660 to £68,579 in London and from €46,027 to €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £151,436 in London or €145,430 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. Manager, Customer Success, Multi-Asset Trading, Southern Europe As a Manager of the Trading Customer Success Team for Southern Europe, you'll lead a dynamic team of 7-8 individual contributors, playing a pivotal role in shaping the retention and customer experience for LSEG’s Trading Workflow clients. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Success, Sales & Trading EMEA, you'll be an integral part of the EMEA Customer Success Leadership Team, where your insights and leadership will drive impactful strategies and elevate our customer success initiatives. The successful candidate will focus on ensuring clients realise the full value of our platforms to achieve their business goals through the creation of success strategies that drive adoption, integration, and expansion. Leadership Activities: Lead and develop a team of high performing  CSMs with deep trading industry expertise. Develop the CSM strategy for the Trading proposition (KPIs, marketing, community, playbooks) and ensure execution of regional and global CSM programs. Create the strategy to recruit diverse talent, onboard, and develop existing talent to achieve the Customer Success mandate and drive employee engagement. Develop a culture of customer success, accountability, and collaboration across key stakeholders: sales, customer operations, and product strategy. Collaborate with regional and global peers to share best practices and create community. Provide thought leadership to shape the CSM organisation at the proposition, regional and global level. Customer Advocate: Build strong client relationships to understand the market needs and drive voice of the customer internally for all decision making. Collaborate with the wider Customer Success leadership team, product strategy and sales enablement to ensure the voice of the customer is aligned to retention campaigns and product strategy. Drive awareness of the Customer Success team and value proposition with clients. Participate in industry events for both Clients and Customer Success, be a brand ambassador for LSEG and bring trends back into the business to shape the organisation. Commercial Engagement: Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure retention campaigns and talent are aligned to drive positive renewal outcomes. Collaborate with Sales and Customer Operations to ensure smooth hand offs in customer journey for optimal renewal and expansion outcomes. Monitor and report on the overall customer health, adoption metrics, renewals, expansion opportunities and execution of Customer Success Plans. Collaborate with product strategy to ensure upgrade, migration, and adoption campaigns are launched and achieved. Identify opportunities / risks and areas of improvement to the Sales and Account Management leadership team and align on actions to address. Success Metrics in Role: Usage Retention Annual Subscription Value Revenue Growth Adoption KPIs Customer Satisfaction Employee Engagement Talent Development Who are we looking for: Candidates should have people leadership experience. We are looking for someone who is a seasoned mentor and coach equipped to nurture, develop and identify talent. Experience in Customer Success or account management, with a strong grasp of how customer success drives value throughout the customer lifecycle. Ability to work in a team-based, collaborative environment and passion for contributing to the creation of a world-class customer success function. Consistent track record of exceeding retention, adoption, customer satisfaction, and growth targets. Demonstrated understanding of customer needs and technology trends with ability to develop strategy and execute. Innovator who utilises data to inform decisions, creative problem solver, and ability to give constructive feedback to drive results. Experience in delivering work from a regional perspective in a cross-functional capacity would be an advantage. Strong knowledge of the financial markets, with a deep understanding of the Trading workflow, especially from a data vendor perspective Exceptional team member engagement skills, fostering alignment and collaboration across various departments to achieve common goals. You will have the power to influence the C-Suite and connect effectively at all levels. Proficient in change management, adept at guiding teams through transitions and fostering a culture of adaptability. Committed to driving a high-performance culture, setting bold goals, and motivating teams to achieve excellence across diverse cultures & geographies. Exceptional organisational skills, capable of leading multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Strong performance mentor skills, with the ability to set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and support professional development. Why Join Us? We're proud to offer a working culture that supports growth, balance, and purpose: Hybrid and flexible working arrangements. Constant Learning: 90 Day Sales On-Boarding Program, E-learning platform, a range of workshops, access to real-time economic data. A welcoming, inclusive culture backed by Employee Networks. A competitive referral bonus program. Access to private healthcare, wellness support, and pension contributions. Professional development:Quarterly Connects to ensure you meet your Goals & Objectives. Paid volunteer time to support causes that matter to you. A team that values your input and supports your goals. We believe diversity makes us stronger. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know - we're here to support you!
